title: Lithuanian holiday payload
description: Date lists. Lithuanian PUBLIC holidays are computed by the library from the rule and need no data at all; this file carries only what cannot be derived -- exchange closures and half-days, which are announced.

public_holidays.description: For cross-checking the computed rule only. The rule remains the authority, because a rule cannot go stale.

exchange_holidays_by_venue.description: AUTHORITATIVE where present. A date added only to the global list has no effect for a venue that has its own -- the easiest mistake to make here, and what `ingest verify` checks for.

half_days.description: Date to early-close time, HH:MM local. A full closure cannot also be a half-day.
